title: Updating the memory base
statement: Let a machine state have natural-number registers $(N,L_g,s,s_1,X,w,K,B_s,U,V,T,T_2,Z,C,ch,c,c_1)$, and let its register vector list these values in that order, indexed from $0$ to $16$. Replacing coordinate $7$ of the vector by a natural number $k$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by setting $B_s=k$ and leaving the other registers unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: state has the listed natural-number registers
coordinate vector lists registers in the displayed order
replacement value k is a natural number
replaced:
Let $st$ be a state with natural-number registers
$N,Lg,s,s1,X,w,K,Bs,U,V,T,T2,Z,C,ch,c,c1$, and let $v(st)$ be the vector of these
registers in the displayed order. For every natural number $k$, changing coordinate $7$
of $v(st)$ to $k$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing $Bs$ with
$k$ and leaving all other registers unchanged.
